campWords.BACKDROP: the backdrop: rates, oil, gold, bonds, defensives

noBackdrop.label: the five backdrop rows stop voting

noBackdropDefRel.label: … and defensives read against the index

momentum.label: the Geiger rows read their momentum half only

fix.label: the proposed repair: backdrop out, defensives against the index, momentum half

flipSafety.label: the 10-year and long bonds turned over instead of taken out

baseSectors.label: the tool as it stands, with the sector row read as the eleven funds' own Geigers

fixSectors.label: the repair, with the sector row read as the eleven funds' own Geigers

whyAbsent.SECTORS: the blended sector bow tie needs five readings per sector and only one of them (the fund's own Geiger) has a past
whyAbsent.CURVE: the 2-year yield: the treasury table starts 3 Aug 2020 and the chart API carries no 2-year
whyAbsent.VIX_TERM: the 3-month VIX: the VIX table carries it from 18 Sep 2009
whyAbsent.ADLINE: the candidate names' daily closes reach back 5,000 sessions (Nov 2006)

heat1Check.note: HEAT1 read the provider's ready-made 3D and W bars, the one-day advance/decline fallback and the internals rows on their stamped dates; this replay builds the bars itself, uses the 20-session line and reads the internals on the session they describe — so the Geiger rows should match closely and those three rows should not
